method: clean git worktrees, make -j12 toke; --emit-llvm IR differential over every susceptible record, then build+run for those that differ
verdict: No recorded-as-correct output is wrong. Zero records change output silently (zero IR differences). 137 records use a bare-property spelling that only ever resolved by reading raw struct bytes; the fixed compiler rejects them (E4034/E4025). All 10 that the corpus marks validated use it on single-character strings only, so the byte read coincides with the correct value and every banked output was verified correct.
